Together We Reinvented

Perspective
How CHROs can turn workforce reinvention into AI-powered value

Explore how leaders can redesign work, accelerate skills and reinvent HR so people and AI work together to create measurable growth, stronger experiences and lasting enterprise value in the Human + AI era.

Expand
Research Report
The network that thinks for every customer

Building autonomous networks for personalized telecom experiences.

Expand
Research Report
The capital projects execution gap

Research from 1,050 leaders and workers shows why capital project strategy is not reaching the site and what it takes to close the execution gap.

Expand
Research Report
Pulse of Change: What’s top of mind for today’s leaders

After two years of rapid AI acceleration, global executives enter 2026 with unmistakable confidence. But beneath the optimism, data shows a series of gaps standing in the way of scale and value.

Expand
Case Study
McDonald's strengthens the foundation behind every feel-good moment

Behind the scenes, McDonald's is rebuilding how the business operates, while staying true to what customers love most about the brand.

Expand
Perspective
AI tokenomics for enterprise value

Accenture explores AI tokenomics, AI ROI and enterprise AI economics to connect spend with business value. Learn how leaders maximize returns.

Expand
Perspective
Power first: The new playbook for data center development

AI is pushing power demand beyond grid limits. Winning data center developers are shifting to a power-first strategy, securing capacity early, aligning with utilities, and designing for flexibility.

Expand
Research Report
Redefining Resilience: To survive new threats, leaders must address a perception gap

In today’s AI driven threat landscape, cyber resilience is a strategic mandate. See 5 actions leaders can align on to ensure their business keeps running when—not if—disruption happens.

Expand

“Companies will have a greater technology landscape, but we need to completely change the narrative to inspire people to paint the future. It is human in the lead, not human in the loop.”

Julie Sweet

Client spotlight

Reinvented with Accenture

Across industries, CEOs are rewriting the rules of growth, innovation and resilience. Hear directly from these leaders in our exclusive video series hosted by Accenture CEO Julie Sweet.

Global recognition and awards

A Leader in Reinvention​

Recognized by Forbes as the top company on its World’s Best Management Consulting Firms list and named one of The Wall Street Journal’s Top 30 Best Companies for the Future, reflecting the talent, innovation and agility that make Accenture the trusted reinvention partner for clients worldwide.​

See related awards

A Great Place To Work

We are very proud to have earned the No. 4 spot on the Great Place To Work® list of the World’s Best Workplaces™, our highest-ever ranking on this prestigious list.

This recognition is especially meaningful because it is based on feedback from our people worldwide.

See related awards

A Trusted Industry Leader

Accenture is a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Public Cloud IT Transformation Services.

Accenture placed highest on the Ability to Execute axis in the Magic Quadrant report, which assessed a total of 15 PCITS providers.

See related awards

Industries Client Stories Expand Menu Reinvention Partners Reinvention Engines Client Success Industries Client Stories Reinvention Services Pause video We help you reinvent boldly, continuously and at speed Reinvention Services brings together the full breadth of Accenture to create solutions to our clients' most complex problems and deliver more value faster. Designed entirely around how our clients think about their business issues and organize their operations, Reinvention Services enables us to embed data and AI more easily into our solutions and deliver reinvention for you at greater scale and impact. “This exceptional group of leaders integrates our industry depth, technology and AI expertise, ecosystem relationships, creativity and operational scale into one seamless experience for clients that drives measurable outcomes.” Manish Sharma Chief Strategy & Services Officer Reinvention Partners Reinvention Partners are responsible for helping clients reinvent. Cybersecurity Close We’re helping clients reinvent cyber-resilience and value through trust—building defenses, protecting enterprises, managing risk and enabling emerging technologies. Harpreet Sidhu Lead – Cybersecurity Digital Core Close We’re helping clients reinvent their digital foundations—including technology strategy and architecture, data and AI, modernizing and managing applications, infrastructure, data and cloud. Ajoy Menon Lead – Digital Core Finance Close We’re helping clients reinvent financial performance by supporting the CFO agenda—driving best-in-class performance and delivering insights and benchmarking across the enterprise. Arundhati Chakraborty Lead – Finance Industry and Enterprise Close We’re helping clients reinvent core industry value chains and drive end-to-end, cross-functional reinvention to deliver growth and long-term value. Muqsit Ashraf Lead – Industry and Enterprise Song Close We’re helping clients reinvent how they grow by focusing on the end-to-end customer agenda, bringing together customer growth strategy, marketing, sales, service, commerce, design, digital products, data, and AI to create customer-led growth. Learn more Ndidi Oteh Lead – Song Supply Chain and Engineering Close We’re helping clients leverage AI and digital technologies across product and asset lifecycles to build competitive advantage. Tracy Countryman Lead – Supply Chain and Engineering Talent Close We’re helping clients reinvent how people and organizations work—delivering leadership, talent, operating models and change to accelerate the workforce agenda. Karalee Close Lead – Talent Reinvention Engines Reinvention Engines are where Accenture reinvents itself—how we develop stronger, more specialized skills; AI-enabled ways of delivering services; cutting-edge innovation, and the most advanced tools and methods. Together, the Reinvention Engines work as an elite university, the world’s best innovation lab and a powerhouse of industrialization all rolled into one. AI and Data Close We build and scale AI and data capabilities globally; advance AI and data training across Accenture; and develop cutting-edge methods for designing, building and delivering the most modern AI and data foundation in the technology stack and embedding AI and data across the enterprise, powered by Accenture’s Center for Advanced AI. Lan Guan Chief AI & Data Officer Industry and Process Close We build and scale even deeper industry and process expertise, establish industry and process training across Accenture, and develop AI-enabled methods to transform enterprises, such as AI-enabled ERP methods and ART, our proprietary reinvention methodology, powered by Accenture’s Intelligent Operations Centers and Global Network Centers. Jason Dess Lead – Industry and Process Technology Close We build and scale advanced technology capabilities, advance technology training across Accenture, and develop the latest modern technology stacks, powered by Accenture Technology Centers. Rajendra Prasad Lead – Technology Client Success Client Success is designed to ensure we stay relentlessly focused on our clients. Commercial Close We ensure that we sell clients what they truly need, bringing the full strength of Accenture to every solution and creating win-win commercial models. We also seek and act on client feedback, and develop and support our client account leads. Shaheen Sayed Chief Commercial Officer Offerings and Products Close We develop differentiated offerings and products aligned to evolving client needs. Senthil Ramani Chief Offerings and Products Officer Integrated Delivery Governance and Integrated Quality Close We deliver client outcomes through Accenture’s global delivery capabilities and strengthen quality and consistency across engagements. David Golding Lead – Integrated Delivery Governance and Integrated Quality We bring deep industry expertise INDUSTRIES Aerospace and Defense Automotive Banking Capital Markets Chemicals Communications and Media Consumer Goods and Services Energy Health High Tech Industrial Insurance Life Sciences Natural Resources Public Service Private Equity Retail Software & Platforms Travel US Federal Government Utilities We make reinvention real More stories of reinvention Close Case Study Microsoft scales cloud at the speed of AI Data center capacity to double in 10 years, with 38GW needed for AI by 2028 - and US capacity reaching 21GW this year. Expand Close Case Study Tracr pioneers trust in diamond traceability A revolutionary blockchain platform for diamond traceability allows users to securely track and verify the provenance of diamonds, ensuring ethical sourcing and authenticity in every transaction. Expand Close Case Study Uber hails a new era for advertising Streamlined operations and a new self-serve platform have helped the company reach over $1 billion in ad sales in just 2.5 years. Expand Close Case Study Vodafone: Reinventing customer service with gen AI Through the power of generative AI, UK telecoms company Vodafone’s youth brand VOXI mobile has reimagined its customer service chatbot to be youthful, professional, faster and more accurate than ever. Expand Close Case Study ESPN scores with GenAI Together, we're bringing a wider array of sports coverage to mainstream media, giving fans more access to the teams, athletes and content they love. Expand Close Case Study Fortune turns years of data into instant insights Accenture and Fortune transformed the iconic Fortune 500® list into an AI-driven platform that gives business leaders access to insights like never before.           <h2>Shaping tomorrow, today</h2>
<p>The forces shaping business today are opening new possibilities for growth. AI is moving beyond experimentation and into the core of the enterprise, giving companies new ways to innovate, operate and compete.</p>
<p><i>Reinvented with Accenture</i> brings together stories of organizations turning possibility into impact through technology, data, AI and human ingenuity.</p>
<p>In our exclusive video series, join Accenture CEO Julie Sweet in conversation with the leaders behind these transformations, exploring how they are creating new business value, accelerating growth, improving efficiency and building resilience.</p>

AI is moving beyond experimentation and into the core of the enterprise, giving companies new ways to innovate, operate and compete. Reinvented with Accenture brings together stories of organizations turning possibility into impact through technology, data, AI and human ingenuity. In our exclusive video series, join Accenture CEO Julie Sweet in conversation with the leaders behind these transformations, exploring how they are creating new business value, accelerating growth, improving efficiency and building resilience. McDonald's Poste Italiane Al Etihad Payments Vodafone Best Buy BBVA Julie Sweet sits down with Chris Kempczinski, Chairman and CEO of McDonald's, to discuss how one of the world's most iconic brands is preserving the experience customers love while adapting to a rapidly changing world. Behind the scenes, McDonald's is reinventing the systems, data and operations that power the business—creating a stronger foundation for what's next. Read more Watch the full interview View Transcript Julie Sweet sits down with Matteo Del Fante, CEO of Poste Italiane, to unpack the company’s bold reinvention—from legacy postal service to Italy’s largest phygital platform. Now connecting over 45 million citizens to essential services, Poste Italiane is redefining its role as a national institution—setting new benchmarks for customer experience, operational agility, and digital access. Read more Watch the full interview View Transcript Julie Sweet sits down with Jan Pilbauer, CEO of Al Etihad Payments, to explore how the UAE is reshaping its financial landscape by making bold moves toward a more inclusive and digital economy. At the center of that transformation is Aani—an instant payments platform that’s revolutionizing how over 1.5 million people and 100,000 merchants transact daily. Aani is driving financial inclusion, reducing cash dependency, and positioning the UAE as a global FinTech leader. Read more Watch the full interview View Transcript Julie Sweet talks with Margherita Della Valle, CEO of Vodafone, about how the company is scaling excellence through reinvention—turning internal strength into industry impact. By transforming its internal shared services into a commercial engine—Vodafone Intelligent Solutions (VOIS)—Vodafone is accelerating growth, enhancing customer experience, and delivering operational efficiency across its markets. VOIS now serves not only Vodafone’s own business but also industry partners, creating new career opportunities and redefining what shared services can achieve at scale. Read more Watch the full interview View Transcript Julie Sweet sits down with Corie Barry, CEO of Best Buy, to explore the company’s remarkable reinvention. From the decline of VCRs and compact discs to the rise of online shopping and generative AI, Best Buy has continuously evolved to stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations. Today, it’s transforming its retail floors into dynamic hubs for emerging technologies—managing change with agility and leading in a rapidly evolving industry. Read more Watch the full interview View Transcript Julie Sweet talks with Carlos Torres Vila, Chair of BBVA, about the bank’s bold reinvention—transforming its core business to lead in the digital era. In partnership with Accenture, BBVA has launched a transformative strategy that’s delivering record-breaking growth, including a 117% increase in new customers. With nearly 50 million users now engaging through digital channels, BBVA’s AI-powered onboarding and sales model is setting a new benchmark for customer-centric banking and redefining performance across the financial industry. Read more Watch the full interview View Transcript Reinventing the future of sport In a landscape defined by constant change, reinvention isn’t a one-time play—it’s a continuous strategy. As goals shift and the fields, courts, and courses evolve, organizations are reimagining how they operate, compete, and grow with greater precision and purpose.
